lamina.name: Tempest
lamina.description: Wandering swordsmen who fight up close with the fury of thunder. Every hit restores a little health.

recommended.reason: accuracy and crits suit fast strikes

pavilhao.name: Frost
pavilhao.description: Masters of spiritual energy who strike from afar with the ice of the mountains.

lamina.name: Twin Fangs
lamina.description: Two quick strikes on the target, each for 80% of your normal damage.

lamina.name: Lightning Step
lamina.description: Dash to the target (up to 8 tiles, needs a clear path) and hit it for 120% damage.

lamina.name: Blade Storm
lamina.description: Spin your blades to deal 170% damage to all monsters within 2.5 tiles. No target needed.

lamina.name: Guardbreak
lamina.description: Heavy strike for 280% damage that lowers the target's defense by 40% for 6 s.

lamina.name: Blade Flow
lamina.description: Passive: +10% attack speed and +5% crit chance. Grows with your level.

pavilhao.name: Frost Orb
pavilhao.description: Hurl an ice orb that deals 130% of your normal damage. Range 7.

pavilhao.name: Icebloom
pavilhao.description: An ice flower that deals 110% damage and slows the target by 40% for 4 s.

pavilhao.name: Blizzard
pavilhao.description: A blizzard that deals 180% damage to all monsters within 2.5 tiles of the target.

pavilhao.name: Mist Veil
pavilhao.description: Wrap yourself in mist that absorbs damage equal to 25% of max health for 8 s. No target needed.

pavilhao.name: Serene Mind
pavilhao.description: Passive: regenerates 1% of max mana per second outside town. Grows with your level.

inicio.title: Welcome!
inicio.text: Click the ground to move. Click a monster to select it and your character attacks on its own. Tab switches target and Space attacks the nearest one.
inicio.textTouch: Use the joystick on the left to move. Tap a monster to select it and use the Attack button on the right.

portal.title: Portal
portal.text: This portal leads to the forest, where monsters await. Walk into it to cross. If things get hard, you respawn in the village.

primeiro_abate.title: First kill
primeiro_abate.text: Defeating monsters gives experience (XP). Watch the yellow bar on your panel: when it fills, you level up.

primeiro_nivel.title: Level up!
primeiro_nivel.text: You gained free attribute points. Open the panel with the C key (or the Attributes button) and spend them. The recommended attributes for your class are marked, and the "Distribute recommended" button spends everything at once.
primeiro_nivel.textTouch: You gained free attribute points. Tap the Attributes button and spend them. The recommended attributes for your class are marked, and the "Distribute recommended" button spends everything at once.

primeira_morte.title: Back to the village
primeira_morte.text: When you die you return to the village and each equipped item loses 10% of its max durability. Items at 0 durability stop giving bonuses: repair them with the Blacksmith.

primeira_skill.title: New skill!
primeira_skill.text: Use your skills with keys 1 to 4 or by clicking the buttons on the bar below. Each skill costs mana and has a cooldown. The more you use a skill, the higher it levels and the stronger it gets. Open the skills panel with the K key (or the Skills button) to see them all.
primeira_skill.textTouch: Use your skills with the buttons arcing around the Attack button. Each skill costs mana and has a cooldown. Hold a button to see its details. The more you use a skill, the higher it levels and the stronger it gets. The Skills button shows them all.

skill_nivel.title: Skill level up!
skill_nivel.text: Active skills gain experience with every use and get 8% stronger per level (max 10). Passives level up along with your character level. See the progress in the skills panel (K).

primeiro_item.title: You found equipment!
primeiro_item.text: Open the bag with the I key (or the Bag button). The name color shows the rarity: white (common), green (uncommon, 1 bonus) and blue (rare, 2 bonuses). Double-click an item to equip it; hover to see details and compare with what you are wearing.
primeiro_item.textTouch: Open the bag with the Bag button. The name color shows the rarity: white (common), green (uncommon, 1 bonus) and blue (rare, 2 bonuses). Tap an item to see its details and use the Equip button.

primeira_pocao.title: Potions
primeira_pocao.text: Use the Q key for a health potion and E for a mana potion. They heal gradually over 8 seconds, and using another of the same type restarts the effect. Buy more from the Potion Seller in the village.
primeira_pocao.textTouch: Use the potion buttons above the joystick: health (HP) and mana (MP). They heal gradually over 8 seconds, and using another of the same type restarts the effect. Buy more from the Potion Seller in the village.

primeiro_npc.title: Villagers
primeiro_npc.text: Click a villager to walk up to them and open their window. The Blacksmith repairs equipment and the Potion Seller buys and sells items.
primeiro_npc.textTouch: Tap a villager to walk up to them and open their window. The Blacksmith repairs equipment and the Potion Seller buys and sells items.

durabilidade_baixa.title: Gear wearing out
durabilidade_baixa.text: An equipped item is low on durability. Repair it with the Blacksmith in the village. At 0 durability, the item stops giving bonuses (but is not lost).

mochila_cheia.title: Bag full
mochila_cheia.text: The bag has 30 slots. The item stays on the ground for 60 seconds: free up space (sell items to the Potion Seller) and walk over it to pick it up.

primeiro_ouro.title: Gold
primeiro_ouro.text: Monsters drop gold. Use it to repair equipment and buy potions. Items you don't use can be sold to the Potion Seller.

auto_combate.title: Auto-battle
auto_combate.text: The Auto button (or the Z key) makes your character hunt on its own: it picks the nearest monster (up to 2 levels above you), uses your skills and drinks potions. Moving your character pauses auto; press Z again to resume. The gear next to the button opens the menu: choose skills, potion limits and how much to buy in the village.
auto_combate.textTouch: The Auto button makes your character hunt on its own: it picks the nearest monster (up to 2 levels above you), uses your skills and drinks potions. Moving with the joystick pauses auto; tap Auto again to resume. The gear next to it opens the menu: choose skills, potion limits and how much to buy in the village.

ganho_offline.title: Earnings while you are away
ganho_offline.text: Leave Auto on in a hunting map when you close the game and you get XP, gold and items for the time away, at the pace auto measured before you left. It pays 60% up to 12 h, 40% from 12 h to 18 h, 20% from 18 h to 24 h and nothing after that. No deaths, and potions are used at the measured pace.

bandidos.title: Bandits
bandidos.text: Bandit Archers shoot from afar and back off when you get close. Close the distance fast (or use a ranged skill) and kill the archer first. The swordsmen move in groups: attack one and the rest of the gang joins in.

terracota.title: Physical and spiritual defense
terracota.text: Terracotta Warriors have high physical defense and low spiritual defense. Spiritual damage (Frost sect) pierces their armor; physical damage does much less.

byClass.lamina: Tip: Guardbreak lowers the target's defense and makes your physical strikes stronger. Use it before your other skills.
byClass.pavilhao: Tip: you are spiritual, so you have the advantage here.

chefe.title: General's Arena
chefe.text: You entered the Terracotta General's arena. Red circles on the ground show where the area strike will land in 1.5 seconds: get out of the circle before it fills. At half health he summons warriors. Auto-battle does not fight the boss.

lamina.name: Master Lei
lamina.title: Tempest Master
lamina.greeting: Thunder waits for no one, young one. Come, let us see if you keep up.
lamina.intro: In the Tempest we fight up close, with twin swords and fast strikes charged with Thunder. Our damage is physical and swift. Those who walk this path should favor Strength and Agility.
tips: Use Guardbreak on the terracotta warriors: it lowers their defense by 30% and opens the way for everything else.
Lightning Step carries you to your target in an instant. Use it to reach archers who shoot from afar.
Surrounded by bandits? Blade Storm strikes everything around you. If you die a lot, put points into Stamina.

pavilhao.name: Mistress Shuang
pavilhao.title: Frost Mistress
pavilhao.greeting: Breathe deep and calm your mind. Frost comes with stillness.
pavilhao.intro: In Frost, we wield qi through a fan, striking from afar with Ice magic. Our damage is spiritual and area-based, and we can attack while walking. Favor Intelligence and Willpower.
tips: You attack while walking. Back away without ever ceasing to cast Frost Orb, and keep the wolves at a distance.
Icebloom deals damage and slows the target. Pair it with Blizzard to dominate groups of bandits.
Terracotta warriors have fragile spirits. Our spiritual damage hurts them far more than ordinary blades.

tita.name: Master Gang
tita.title: Titan Master
tita.greeting: Hm. Even the mountain knows how to wait.
tita.intro: In the Titan sect, we hold the front line with staff or fists, taking the blows for everyone. We are the wall that shields our companions. Ours is a path of endurance and raw strength.
tita.locked: The gates of the Titan are not yet open to new disciples; return when the mountain is ready.

vibora.name: Mistress Du
vibora.title: Viper Mistress
vibora.greeting: Quiet as a shadow, patient as venom.
vibora.intro: In the Viper sect, we strike from afar with poisoned needles. Venom wears the enemy down little by little, and our arts even mend allies a bit. Here, the patient prevail.
vibora.locked: The gates of the Viper are still closed to new disciples; return in another season.

guarda.name: Gate Guard
lines: Heading out the east gate? Near the entrance of the Dark Forest, hungry wolves prowl. Good prey for a beginner.
Deeper in the forest lie the bandit camps. Swordsmen move in groups of two or three. Do not fight them surrounded.
Beware the bandit archers. They shoot from afar, so close the distance fast or find cover.
Beyond the forest lie the Terracotta Ruins. The clay warriors have towering physical defense, but their spirit is frail.
At the back of the ruins stands the Terracotta General. When a red circle appears on the ground, step out of it. And repair your gear at the blacksmith.

anciao.name: Elder
lines: Cloud Village was born centuries ago, when weary travelers stopped beneath the mist of these hills and chose to stay.
Long ago, the four sects protected the village: Tempest, Frost, Titan and Viper. Together, no danger could reach us.
In the ruins to the east sleeps the terracotta army of a forgotten emperor. No one knew there was life in that clay.
One day, something woke the General. His warriors rose, and the forest filled with bandits and beasts.
Now the sects need new disciples. If you have courage, young one, choose a master and help the village regain its peace.

mercador.name: Traveling Merchant
lines: Ah, traveler! I have walked a thousand roads, yet my carts are still empty for now.
I have nothing to sell today. I await rare goods from distant lands, and they say the wait is worth it.
Silk from the south, spices from the desert, relics from forgotten monasteries... all of it may arrive someday.
Come back later, friend. Perhaps I will have something worthy of a warrior like you.

morador1.name: Villager Mei
lines: My husband swears a wolf chased him to the gate. I think it was just a frightened dog.
Drink a potion when you are hurt, but remember: it heals gradually, over eight seconds.
When you return from the forest, rest in the village. Here your health and energy recover on their own.

morador2.name: Old Fisher Hu
lines: I have fished this stream for forty years and only ever hooked boots. But they are very fine boots!
If your potions are running low, do not wait for the final blow. Drink in time, because healing is not instant.
Only in the village does the body renew fully. In the forest, every drop of life counts.

morador3.name: Little Tao
lines: When I grow up, I will be a great Tempest master! I already defeated three chickens with a stick.
Grandfather says the blacksmith can mend anything. Even my wooden sword, if I ask politely.
They say the Terracotta General is huge and slow. I would run away, but not slowly, mind you.

morador4.name: Cook Lan
lines: Fresh hot buns! Oh, they are not for sale, they are for the guards. But the smell is free.
An adventurer with an empty belly fights poorly. Rest in the village, where the body mends itself.
The potion seller buys anything you bring. Even that junk you found in the forest.

chain.name: Welcome
chain.offer: You arrived just in time, young one. Before taking up arms, present yourself to your sect master in the square. They will guide your first steps.
chain.done: So you are the new disciple. The elder did well to send you to me.

chain.name: First Training
chain.offer: Strikes at the air teach nothing. Head into the Dark Forest through the east gate and defeat 5 wolves. Come back when you are done.
chain.done: Not bad. Your body is starting to understand the way of the sect.

chain.name: Wolves on the Road
chain.offer: Packs are prowling the forest road and the merchants cannot get through. Defeat 8 wolves and the road will be safe again.
chain.done: The road is calmer now. The merchants thank you, and so do I.

chain.name: The Camps
chain.offer: Bandits have set up camps deep in the forest. The swordsmen move in groups, so be careful. Defeat 6 of them.
chain.done: You took on the groups alone? Keep this weapon from the village armory. Use it when you are ready.

chain.name: Stolen Cargo
chain.offer: The bandit archers attacked my cart and took half my cargo! Defeat 4 of them. They shoot from afar, so close in fast.
chain.done: My cargo is gone, but at least they will not rob anyone else. Here, for your help.

chain.name: The Ancient Gate
chain.offer: At the end of the forest road there is a stone portal leading to the emperor's ruins. Go there and tell me what you saw.
chain.done: Clay warriors walking among the columns... So the stories were true. Talk to your master: they will know what to do.

chain.name: Clay and Bronze
chain.offer: The terracotta warriors resist blades well, but clay has weak points. Defeat 8 of them and learn how to break them.
chain.done: Now you know the enemy. Wear this: a disciple who will face the General needs better protection.

chain.name: The General Awakens
chain.offer: The Terracotta General commands everything from the depths of the ruins. While he stands, the village will have no peace. Defeat him. Step out of the red circle when he raises his blade.
chain.done: The General has fallen! Cloud Village will remember your name for generations. This gold is little next to what you did.
